title: Oceans and Seas
description: A quiz about the waters of the world: depths and trenches, currents and tides, straits and the people who crossed them.

questions.prompt: How many grams of salt are dissolved in one litre of average seawater?
questions.explanation: That works out at about three and a half percent salt by weight.
